summary: WAM must not count active holdings whose maturity date is already in the past; negative days-to-maturity must be excluded from the weighted average, not folded in.
reason: An active (not yet Redeemed/Cancelled) holding inside a T+2 settlement window or after a stale sync can have a maturity_date in the past, yielding negative days that dragged WAM toward zero or negative. Guard hasDays on days >= 0.
